name: Gamma
description: Transform ideas into presentations, documents, social media posts, and websites directly from Claude. Gamma generates beautifully designed content from prompts or notes, with smart layouts, customizable themes, and AI visuals. Work in 60+ languages, control tone and detail level, and export to PDF or PPTX — all without leaving your workflow in Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Gamma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Gamma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.gamma.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Gamma MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gamma provides these MCP tools: generate, get_themes, and get_folders.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Gamma?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Gamma in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Gamma requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Gamma is developed by Gamma. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
